title: GLW4 gridded livestock densities (2020 vintage)
description: Gridded Livestock of the World v4, 2020 reference year, 10 km. FAO GLW4 dysymmetric DENSITY rasters (animals per km2), the input to livestock numbers and value of production.

transfer.rationale: Public FAO release on Google Cloud Storage, CC-BY-4.0, ~70 MB for the six species. Every host fetches its own copy.

gaps: Confirm on-disk filenames on a host that already holds these files. list.files(glw_dir, '.tif$') globs the whole directory, so a second copy under different names would be stacked alongside the first and silently double the species set. Evidence the products match: a fresh fetch reproduces a cattle density global sum of 2.0384e7, the exact value documented for the CGlabs copy at R/0.4.1_create_livestock_exposure.R:101.
These are per-km2 DENSITY, not per-pixel counts; 0.4.1 multiplies by cellSize to convert. The 2015 vintage was already per-pixel. Do not mix them.

changelog.change: Record created. Flagged the missing origin - this is the clearest reproducibility gap the catalogue has surfaced so far.

Origin pinned to the FAO data catalogue (GLW4-2020, 10 km, CC-BY-4.0) and an acquire recipe added - this was the last dataset with no way to reproduce it on a new host. All six species endpoints verified reachable (HTTP 200). Verified end to end on the laptop: 6 files fetched through atlas_require(), all parse at 0.0833 deg global extent, the 0.4.1 first-token species mapping resolves with no NA, and cattle sums to 2.0384e7 as documented.

acquire.note: Filenames matter. R/0.4.1_create_livestock_exposure.R takes the FIRST underscore-separated token of each filename as the species code (Ct/Sh/Gt/Pg/Ch/Bf) and maps it to a long name, so dest names must start with that code. Note this differs from the 2015 vintage, whose '5_Ct_2015_Da.tif' naming would yield a first token of '5'. GLW4-2020.D-DA.GLEAM3-ALL-LU.tif is a land-use layer, not a species, and is deliberately not fetched - it would be picked up by the list.files() glob and corrupt the stack. Horses and ducks have no GLW4-2020 release; the pipeline subsets to poultry/sheep/pigs/goats/cattle anyway.
